name: music-benchmark-dataset
description: A collection of music-related evaluation tasks aimed at benchmarking models on music understanding and processing. It includes a variety of MIR tasks such as classification, transcription, tagging, and retrieval across different audio and symbolic representations. The suite is intended to provide multi-task coverage for models working on music/audio data.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (accuracy / F1 / MAE / BLEU depending on the task)
reputation: A useful multi-task collection for music-information-retrieval research with modest community usage; not yet a universal standard.
